Linda Brent, Incidents in the Life of a Slave Girl, edited by L. Maria Child.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/linda-brent/incidents-in-the-life-of-a-slave-girl

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Linda Brent, the author, died 1897.
- L. Maria Child, the editor and writer of the introduction, died 1880.

First publication of the text used: 1861 (SE colophon: 'Incidents in the Life of a Slave Girl was published in 1861 by Linda Brent.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1861, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1956.
- Country of origin (the facts do not name the country of first publication): the last person to die did so in 1897. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, from 1 January 1998.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
